items.action: 写 tweet——发布本身是头条，但首批口碑两极，值得先实测再下判断。
items.body: 11 月 17 日 17:45 GMT，OpenAI 发布 GPT-6.2 Astra 与 Sol：Astra 为旗舰模型，Sol 为高效日常模型；API 定价 Astra 每百万 tokens 输入 $8 / 输出 $40，Sol $2/$10；上下文 1M；首发 ChatGPT Work 与 Codex（Plus/Pro/Enterprise/Edu 用户）及 API；OpenRouter 同日上架 4 个变体。HN 主帖 769 分 / 477 评。首批体验口碑两极：Artificial Analysis 智能指数 Astra 62.1、Sol 57.3，低于 Claude Fable 5.2 的 64.6 与 Opus 5.5 的 59.1；X 上 Matt Shumer 称“基本不可用”、Theo 称“OpenAI 发过的最差模型”；Reddit r/codex、r/singularity 的首小时帖子评论均超 60 条，价格受好评、实测存疑。

en.action: Write a tweet — the launch itself is the headline, but first reactions are split, so test it before judging.
en.body: At 17:45 GMT on November 17, OpenAI released GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol: Astra is the flagship model, Sol the efficient everyday model. API pricing is $8/$40 per million input/output tokens for Astra and $2/$10 for Sol, with a 1M-token context window. Both launched first in ChatGPT Work and Codex (for Plus/Pro/Enterprise/Edu users) and in the API; OpenRouter listed 4 variants the same day. The HN thread reached 769 points / 477 comments. First hands-on reactions are split: on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, Astra scores 62.1 and Sol 57.3, below Claude Fable 5.2 at 64.6 and Opus 5.5 at 59.1; on X, Matt Shumer called the models "essentially unusable" and Theo called Astra "the worst model OpenAI has ever released"; launch threads in Reddit's r/codex and r/singularity each passed 60 comments in the first hour, with praise for the price and doubts about real-world performance.
en.title: OpenAI releases GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol — launch lands, first reviews split

ja.action: ツイートを書く――発表自体がトップニュースだが、初動の評価は真っ二つ。判断する前にまず試す価値あり。
ja.body: 11月17日17:45 GMT、OpenAIがGPT-6.2 AstraとSolを発表。Astraはフラッグシップ、Solは効率重視の日常モデル。API価格はAstraが100万トークンあたり入力$8/出力$40、Solが$2/$10。コンテキストは1M。まずChatGPT WorkとCodex（Plus/Pro/Enterprise/Eduユーザー）およびAPIで提供開始。OpenRouterも同日に4バリアントを掲載。HNのスレッドは769ポイント/477コメント。初動の評価は真っ二つ。Artificial AnalysisのIntelligence IndexではAstra 62.1、Sol 57.3で、Claude Fable 5.2の64.6、Opus 5.5の59.1を下回る。XではMatt Shumerが「ほぼ使えない」、Theoが「OpenAI史上最悪のモデル」と投稿。Redditのr/codexとr/singularityでは公開1時間以内のスレッドがどちらも60件超のコメントを集め、価格は好評だが実測には疑問の声。
ja.title: OpenAI、GPT-6.2 AstraとSolを発表――初動の評価は真っ二つ

items.body: 定价日就是今天 11 月 18 日，11 月 19 日在纳斯达克上市（代码 ANT）。彭博称认购约 7 倍：发行价区间 $70–78、8.25 亿股，募资最高约 643.5 亿美元；多家报道称可能定在区间上限之上；按 $78 计完全稀释估值约 1.4 万亿美元；另有 260 亿美元来自 AMD、博通、谷歌、微软、英伟达、台积电等供应商的同步私募。昨晚台账：员工期权+RSU 约 $2160 亿（5,300 人）、收入 run rate 截至 10 月 31 日为 $810 亿。

en.action: Just record it — watch tonight's pricing result and report again tomorrow morning.
en.body: Pricing day is today, November 18, with a Nasdaq listing (ticker ANT) on November 19. Bloomberg reports the book is about 7x oversubscribed: the price range is $70–78 for 825 million shares, raising up to about $64.35 billion; several reports say pricing may land above the top of the range; at $78 the fully diluted valuation would be about $1.4 trillion; a further $26 billion comes from a concurrent private placement by suppliers including AMD, Broadcom, Google, Microsoft, Nvidia and TSMC. From last night's ledger: employee options plus RSUs are worth about $216 billion (5,300 people), and the revenue run rate was $81 billion as of October 31.
en.title: Anthropic IPO prices today: book about 7x oversubscribed, may price above the $70–78 range

items.action: 仅记录——供应链攻击的典型样本，留意后续索赔与修复进展。
items.body: 细节核实后升级：攻击者利用 Optimizely 网站测试服务的注册流程漏洞，向 178 家机构的网站访客投放恶意 JavaScript（Report URI 在 1,611 个脚本中发现 188 个被感染），包括 Zoom、BBC、CNN、汇丰、宜家、Salesforce、Equifax；代码可替换加密货币钱包地址、窃取信用卡信息与浏览器 cookie，并向旧款 iPhone/iPad 推送漏洞利用工具；已追踪到约 $7,040 加密货币流入攻击者钱包；Optimizely 称已修复漏洞并清除注入代码。昨晚仅 HN 单源列为 🌱。

en.action: Just record it — a textbook supply-chain attack; watch for claims and remediation follow-ups.
en.body: Upgraded after the details were verified: attackers exploited a flaw in the sign-up flow of Optimizely's website-testing service and served malicious JavaScript to visitors of 178 organizations' websites (Report URI found 188 infected scripts out of 1,611 checked), including Zoom, BBC, CNN, HSBC, IKEA, Salesforce and Equifax. The code could swap cryptocurrency wallet addresses, steal credit-card details and browser cookies, and push exploit kits at older iPhones and iPads; about $7,040 in cryptocurrency has been traced to the attackers' wallets. Optimizely says it has fixed the flaw and removed the injected code. Last night this was a single HN source, listed as an echo.
en.title: Optimizely supply-chain attack reached 178 organizations' websites; about $7,040 in crypto traced

ja.action: 記録のみ――サプライチェーン攻撃の典型例。賠償や修復の続報に注意。
ja.body: 詳細の確認を受けて格上げ。攻撃者はOptimizelyのウェブサイトテストサービスの登録フローの脆弱性を悪用し、178団体のサイト訪問者に悪意あるJavaScriptを配信した（Report URIは1611スクリプト中188件の感染を確認）。Zoom、BBC、CNN、HSBC、IKEA、Salesforce、Equifaxなどが含まれる。コードは暗号資産ウォレットのアドレスをすり替え、クレジットカード情報やブラウザのcookieを盗み、旧型iPhone/iPadにエクスプロイトキットを送り込めた。約7040ドル相当の暗号資産が攻撃者のウォレットに送られたことが確認されている。Optimizelyは脆弱性を修正し、注入コードを除去したと発表。昨夜はHN単独の情報源で🌀扱いだった。
ja.title: Optimizelyのサプライチェーン攻撃、178団体に波及。約7040ドルの暗号資産を確認

items.body: 银行之后轮到更多基础设施：Apple 服务（含 iCloud、App Store、Apple Music）中断，HN 主帖 465 分 / 257 评；NSA 高度机密内网宕机，CNN 引述 6 名知情人士，路透跟进，Mastodon 当日 211 个账号讨论；微软 365 亦宕机，The Verge 报道。Fox News 以“科技中断”做滚动直播，称微软、银行与 FAA 同日出问题。昨晚台账的银行中断（JPMorgan 网银延迟、美联航技术故障已解决）是同一主题的延续。

en.action: Just record it — a social-observation item; watch whether it points to systemic fragility.
en.body: After the banks, more infrastructure went down: Apple services (including iCloud, App Store and Apple Music) were hit by an outage, with the HN thread at 465 points / 257 comments; the NSA's highly classified internal network went down, CNN citing six people familiar with the matter, Reuters following up, and 211 Mastodon accounts discussing it the same day; Microsoft 365 also went down, The Verge reported. Fox News ran a live "tech outages" blog covering Microsoft, banks and the FAA on the same day. Last night's ledger entry on bank outages (JPMorgan online-banking delays; United's tech fault, since resolved) is the same theme continuing.
en.title: Infrastructure outages pile up: Apple services, the NSA's classified network, Microsoft 365
